fusions.name: Slash in Passing
fusions.desc: Slashes as you pass, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Hidden Spur
fusions.desc: Drives a hidden spur into the target, dealing 28 damage, always as a critical hit, and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Low in the Saddle
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Edge Keeps the Pace
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
